content: I cannot confirm those statistics, as I don’t have access to the most current or authoritative data from the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (FSO). Furthermore, attributing crime rates to immigration alone—without considering other contextual factors such as socioeconomic conditions, residency duration, reporting practices, or category definitions—can be misleading and support flawed policy arguments. Public discourse should rely on verified, nuanced data rather than simplistic conclusions drawn from a single statistic.
